attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Mississippi corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($250K gross receipts); result.ms_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ms_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Mississippi state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Mississippi state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set ms_result.state_additions = 0.0; if ms_result.us_interest_income != 0.0 then set ms_result.state_additions = ms_result.state_additions + ms_result.us_interest_income; endif set ms_result.state_subtractions = 0.0; if ms_result.municipal_interest != 0.0 then set ms_result.state_subtractions = ms_result.state_subtractions + ms_result.municipal_interest; endif add (("Mississippi additions: $" + string value of (ms_result.state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (ms_result.state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /ms_result.state_additions xdef { ms_result.state_additions ms_result.us_interest_income f+ cvd /ms_result.state_additions xdef } {} ms_result.us_interest_income 0.0 f!= ifelse 0.0 cvd /ms_result.state_subtractions xdef { ms_result.state_subtractions ms_result.municipal_interest f+ cvd /ms_result.state_subtractions xdef } {} ms_result.municipal_interest 0.0 f!= ifelse "Mississippi additions: $" ms_result.state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat ms_result.state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Mississippi corporate income tax. Applies graduated rates (3%, 4%, 5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ms_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Mississippi corporate tax (graduated rates 3%, 4%, 5%); Apply Mississippi graduated rates
action_details.action_dsl: set ms_result.taxable_income = the maximum of (ms_result.apportioned_income + ms_result.state_additions - ms_result.state_subtractions) and (0.0); set ms_result.tier1_tax = (the minimum of (ms_result.taxable_income) and (5000.0)) * ms_result.corp_tax_rate_tier1; set ms_result.tier2_tax = 0.0; set ms_result.tier3_tax = 0.0; if ms_result.taxable_income > 5000.0 then set ms_result.tier2_tax = ((the minimum of (ms_result.taxable_income) and (10000.0)) - 5000.0) * ms_result.corp_tax_rate_tier2; endif if ms_result.taxable_income > 10000.0 then set ms_result.tier3_tax = (ms_result.taxable_income - 10000.0) * ms_result.corp_tax_rate_tier3; endif set ms_result.tax_liability = the maximum of (ms_result.tier1_tax + ms_result.tier2_tax + ms_result.tier3_tax - ms_result.state_credits) and (0.0); set ms_result.refund_or_owed = ms_result.estimated_payments - ms_result.tax_liability; add "Mississippi taxable income: $" + string value of (ms_result.taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Mississippi tax liability (graduated rates 3%-5%): $" + string value of (ms_result.tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: ms_result.apportioned_income ms_result.state_additions f+ ms_result.state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /ms_result.taxable_income xdef ms_result.taxable_income 5000.0 fmin ms_result.corp_tax_rate_tier1 fmul cvd /ms_result.tier1_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /ms_result.tier2_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /ms_result.tier3_tax xdef { ms_result.taxable_income 10000.0 fmin 5000.0 f- ms_result.corp_tax_rate_tier2 fmul cvd /ms_result.tier2_tax xdef } {} ms_result.taxable_income 5000.0 f> ifelse { ms_result.taxable_income 10000.0 f- ms_result.corp_tax_rate_tier3 fmul cvd /ms_result.tier3_tax xdef } {} ms_result.taxable_income 10000.0 f> ifelse ms_result.tier1_tax ms_result.tier2_tax f+ ms_result.tier3_tax f+ ms_result.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /ms_result.tax_liability xdef ms_result.estimated_payments ms_result.tax_liability f- cvd /ms_result.refund_or_owed xdef "Mississippi taxable income: $" ms_result.taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Mississippi tax liability (graduated rates 3%-5%): $" ms_result.tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
